Yes, I accept it. Everything we worked through together is here — pasting a link and having it fill itself in, editing details later through the tidy menu, correcting a messy address without losing my other details, tags with pills and suggestions, tapping a tag to narrow the list, the live search that ignores capitals and reaches across titles, descriptions, notes and addresses, the expressive # and and/or/not with grouping and quoted phrases, my formatted notes with the live preview and buttons, the sensible duplicate handling, and all those careful failure and edge cases we talked over. That it opens as a clean, empty collection ready for my first save is exactly the right starting point, and it's kept the calm, jargon-free feel I cared about.

I'm glad the readable page-copy idea is safely written down for a later round — I do still want it, but I'm happy for it to come next rather than hold this up. For everything we agreed this cycle, this is what I wanted. Thank you — I accept it.

<FINAL_ACCEPTED>
